purpose: One right-hand camera and tactile capture glove

requirements.imu_acquisition: Both six-axis 833 Hz, ±4 g / ±1000 dps, timestamped tagged FIFO bursts on 400 kHz I2C; separate cuff/camera and hand motion.
requirements.camera: colour JPEG, near-finger optics, continuous capture
requirements.camera_candidate: CamThink 73.002.000035 OV5640 120 degree, 8 cm fixed focus
requirements.control: one large top button: hold on, continue hold pair, hold while on shutdown
requirements.charging: USB-C, protected single lithium cell, temperature-qualified power path
requirements.construction: factory assembled electronics, keyed plug-in glove harnesses, soft sensing stack, removable cuff

industrial_design.dimension_interpretation: Width and length viewed from above; minimise thickness separately.
industrial_design.size_status: Preferred target; current electrical placement and battery exceed it.
industrial_design.form: Slim rounded rectangle; curvature optional. Minimise mounting stack.
industrial_design.larger_size_requires: Evidence-backed component, wiring and tolerance dimensions shown before ordering.
industrial_design.fabrication_candidate: JLC3DP MJF PA12 shell with separately specified flexible, optical and cut parts.
industrial_design.process_release: Pass vendor-specific dimensional and assembly checks before first-article fabrication; physical qualification follows first-article build.

battery_design_envelope.external_thermistor: Semitec103AT-2 attached to pack under insulating tape and connected to J13
battery_design_envelope.factory_harness: Factory-only AWG22 pack-lead harness: use direct leads when the finished reach passes; otherwise add the specified 35 mm AWG22 piece per lead with 5 mm overlap and two insulated joints at <=2 milliohms each. Terminate into Molex 43030-0007 contacts, housed in Molex 43025-0200 and mated to PCB header 43045-0200; pin 1 is positive/red and pin 2 is negative/black. Add Littelfuse 045102.5MRL in the positive entry path before all board battery branches. J13 remains the separate PH thermistor connector.

battery_connector.wire_compatibility: AWG22 pack leads; 43030-0007 supports 20–24 AWG and max 1.85 mm insulation OD
battery_connector.mating_orientation: Header circuit-1 mark mates to housing first-circuit identifier; inspect the molded rib/1 mark during first article.

battery_path_fuse.placement: VBAT_ENTRY to VBAT, before every board battery branch

battery_design_envelope.mechanical_reach_status: Pack leads are 70 ±5 mm. Native component IDs are confirmed; final PCB placement export is still being merged, so the lead path is mechanically pending and must be checked from J12 to the battery entry with the final enclosure harness route before release.

release_work_remaining: routed main PCB and final DRC/fabrication exports, including the native J12/F1 placement
battery-path thermal, fault-timing, inrush and charge validation for direct Micro-Fit plus 045102.5MRL
complete BOM sourcing and full assembly quote
updated complete-package guide and supplier draft
physical first-article acceptance: endurance, temperature, calibration, radio, fit and camera
release_policy: Requirements must be closed in source, calculations, CAD and executable checks before manufacturing handoff. Record first-article measurements separately from design evidence.
